description: This Java class 'ContentPictureInPicture' extends Activity and handles Picture-in-Picture mode; it manages a ResultReceiver to notify when the activity stops and exits in non-Picture-in-Picture mode.

classes.name: ContentPictureInPicture
classes.description: An activity that manages Picture-in-Picture mode and communicates stop events via a ResultReceiver.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, and retrieves a ResultReceiver from the intent.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Sends a completion signal via ResultReceiver when the activity stops.

methods.name: onPictureInPictureModeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in Picture-in-Picture mode; finishes the activity if not in PiP mode.
